The report cautions that audience concern about misinformation does not necessarily mean audiences will return to news media; many distrust news media or rely on comments and AI chatbots for fact-checking.
Fewer than 1% of news images or videos published globally include C2PA metadata; adoption requires ecosystem-wide buy-in, and metadata can be stripped out.
Platforms’ synthetic-content detection systems have been only partly effective; some experts suggest TikTok detects less than half of AI-generated content.
The report says it may become harder to know how AI-mediated use of content affects visits, measurement, and monetisation.
